# ResumeCat

> ResumeCat is an AI-powered resume builder offering ATS-optimized templates, 800+ professional examples, and career resources to help job seekers create winning resumes.

ResumeCat combines artificial intelligence with industry-specific resume templates and examples across accounting, sales, engineering, and other fields. The platform provides both free and premium features to support users throughout their job search journey.

## Core Features

- [AI Resume Builder](https://resumecat.com): ResumeCat's AI-powered resume builder with ATS-friendly templates
- [Resume Templates](https://resumecat.com/resume-templates): Free, ATS-optimized resume templates for professional resume creation
- [Pricing Plans](https://resumecat.com/pricing): ResumeCat pricing plans: Free and Pro with AI credits and features

## Resume Examples & Guidance

- [Resume Examples](https://resumecat.com/resume-examples): 800+ industry-specific resume examples and samples for career guidance
- [Career Resources](https://resumecat.com/resources): Career resources hub: interview questions, skills, cover letters
